parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian беля́ш (beljáš), from Tatar бәлеш (bäleş) or Bashkir бәлеш (bäleş). Compare Kazakh бәліш (bäliš).
Borrowed from Russian колча́н (kolčán), from Tatar колчан (qolçan). Compare Old Ruthenian ковчанъ (kovčan), an earlier discontinued form.

parole.significato: body, bodywork, coachwork (largest or most important part of a vehicle)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian ку́зов (kúzov), from Tatar kyzau̯ (“basket”).
Borrowed from Russian лапша́ (lapšá), from Tatar лакча (laqça) or Uyghur лакча (lakcha). Cognate with ло́кшина (lókšyna).
